title: Multiple File Upload
description: Choose several files at once, and add images through a drop zone with a hidden input, type and size checks, previews, a progress bar per file and remove buttons.

multiple.title: Multiple files
multiple.instructions: Choose one or more files of any type. Every file chosen is listed below.
multiple.label: Choose files

drop-zone.title: Image drop zone
drop-zone.instructions: Drop images on the zone or browse for them. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images up to {{max}} each are accepted. Each image uploads on its own; submit once they have all finished.
drop-zone.prompt: Drag and drop images here, or
drop-zone.wait: Wait for every upload to finish before submitting.
drop-zone.empty: Add at least one image before submitting.

errors.type: {{name}} is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
